parts.text: Many organic compounds contain carbon, hydrogen and oxygen only.

parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) An organic compound V has the following composition by mass. C, 48.65%; H, 8.11%; O, 43.24% Calculate the empirical formula of compound V . empirical formula = .............................. [3]

ms.label: 7(a)
ms.text:
48.65 / 12 8.11 / 1 43.24 / 16 (1)
OR evaluation
4.05 8.11 2.7(0)
divide all by smallest
OR 1.5 : 3 : 1
OR 6 : 3 : 2 (1)
C3H6O2 (1) ALLOW symbols in any order

parts.label: b
parts.text: (b) Compound W has the empirical formula CH 4 O and a relative molecular mass of 32. Calculate the molecular formula of compound W . molecular formula = .............................. [1]

parts.label: c
parts.text: (c) Compounds X and Y have the same general formula. X and Y are both carboxylic acids. Compound X has the molecular formula C 2 H 4 O 2 . Compound Y has the molecular formula C 4 H 8 O 2 .

ms.label: 7(c)(ii)
ms.text:
butanoic acid (1)
fully displayed carboxylic acid group (1)
correct structure of butanoic acid showing all atoms and bonds (1)

parts.label: iii
parts.text: (iii) Give the name used to describe a ‘family’ of similar compounds with the same general formula, similar chemical properties and the same functional group. ....................................................................................................................................... [1]

parts.label: d
parts.text: (d) Propene is an unsaturated hydrocarbon. The formula of propene is shown. CH 3 CH=CH 2

parts.label: ii
parts.text: (ii) Propene can be produced by cracking long chain alkanes. Pentadecane, C 15 H 32 , is cracked to produce an alkane and propene in a 1 : 2 molar ratio. Complete the chemical equation for this reaction. C 15 H 32 → ....................................... + ....................................... [2]

parts.label: iii
parts.text: (iii) Propene can be converted into poly(propene). Name the type of polymerisation that occurs when propene is converted into poly(propene). ....................................................................................................................................... [1]

parts.label: iv
parts.text: (iv) Complete the diagram to show a section of poly(propene). [2]

ms.label: 7(d)(iv)
ms.text:
any one repeat unit (1)
both repeat units fully correct (1)
